name: Billing Portal (Grails)
description: Example customer billing portal built with Grails. Customers log in to view their account and pay their invoices, with an admin area to manage invoices and customers. Run the Billing Portal (Grails) script from any database connection's Seed Data tab to set it up, then fill it with invoices from the Generate Reports tab. Use it as a starting point for building your own document portal.
